transcript_tail.text: we are on mini, i see , we restarted launchd, why we have so many

Found it. Two separate things going on:

**1. Why the long list of entries for `macmini.local`** — those aren't all live servers. The supervisor right now only has 4–6 children alive:

```
mm-job-search, mm-FamilyFund, mm-ai-harness  (+ mm-dstrader/mm-dstrader-docker/mm-dev flapping)
```

Every entry you see in the picker is a registration that a `claude remote-control` process opened with the control plane. When a server exits cleanly it deregisters; when it crashes or gets SIGKILL'd it doesn't, and a phantom entry lingers in the cloud directory until it ages out. We've had a lot of those today — and [logs/launchd.err.log](logs/launchd.err.log) shows why:

**2. The supervisor was crash-looping**, spawning then dying repeatedly:

```
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/Users/user/.local/bin/claude'
  remote_control/supervisor.py:107 in _spawn
```

That's the stale default `REMOTE_CONTROL_CLAUDE_BIN=/Users/user/.local/bin/claude` (note the literal `user`) — the value used to ship in the plist before the host-config split. Each crash-respawn lifetime opened a new `mm-<repo>` registration that never deregistered before the next crash, so the picker accumulated one phantom per cycle per repo. That explains why `dstrader` and `dev` each appear ~4× and `ai-harness`/`job-search` ~2×.

The current supervisor (pid 88699, started 9:30 PM) is using the correct `/Users/claudio1/.local/bin/claude`, so the bleeding has stopped — but the dstrader / dstrader-docker / dev children keep dying after spawn (they're missing from `ps` right now). Want me to:

expected.rec_session: Check why dstrader/dev are flapping, Fix the plist so the bad default can't come back, Force-clear the phantom registrations
